title: One of NASA’s Most Important Deep Space Observatories Hit by Spanish Wildfires
summary: On Friday, wildfires in Spain overran one of three observatories the US National Aeronautics and Space Administration uses to connect with spacecraft, including Voyager 1 , the James Webb Space Telescope, and the recently completed Artemis mission around the Moon.
